not_a_coherence_measure: UER counts definite subjects whose head noun was never introduced, in a fixed window. It has never been validated against a human rating, it is blind to a plain sentence interleave of two stories (see corpus.mutations.interleave), and it must never be used inside snnchat.rerank. See src/snnchat/coherence.py.
interval: Wilson 95%; assumes independent replies, which pool draws are not
